signInNeeded.title: Sign in to continue
signInNeeded.body: This page is for signed-in members.

home.title: Your account
home.subtitle: Signed in as {{email}}
home.privacyBody: Download your data, change your marketing choices or delete your account.
home.securityBody: Confirm your email, turn on two-factor sign-in or set a password.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: You are in control of your personal information. See the <1>privacy notice</1> for the detail.

export.title: Download your data
export.body: A JSON file with your profile, consents, picks and reports.
export.error: We couldn't prepare your file. Please try again.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.body: Marketing is optional and never a condition of using Puntr. Service emails (such as your sign-in code) are not marketing.
marketing.email: Email me news and offers from Puntr
marketing.whatsapp: WhatsApp me news and offers from Puntr
marketing.error: Couldn't save that choice. Please try again.

tracking.title: Analytics and affiliate tracking
tracking.body: Both are off unless you accept them.

request.title: Other requests
request.body: To correct information, object to a use or make a complaint, send a privacy request.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.body: This removes your email, birth year and marketing choices, and signs you out for good. It cannot be undone.
delete.record: Your picks stay on the public record because the record is permanent and verifiable. They stay under a name that no longer points to you (deleted-xxxxxxxxxx).
delete.error: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again or send a privacy request.

record.note: Every pick stays on the record - none can be edited or removed.

stats.sampleNote: {{count}} settled picks. A small sample says little.

record.error: We couldn't load this record. Please refresh the page.
record.legend: W won · L lost · V void

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.body: Share your link. A friend counts once they post their first pick.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.
invite.signedUp_one: {{count}} friend has signed up with your link.
invite.signedUp_other: {{count}} friends have signed up with your link.
invite.rule: Self-referrals and fake accounts don't count.
invite.rewards: When Pay-As-You-Go credits launch, you and each friend who joined will get 15 credits. Rewards are recorded now and granted then. Credits have no cash value and are not available yet.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.body: Stop emails about early access to {{email}}?
unsubscribe.missing: This link is incomplete. Use the unsubscribe link in the email.
unsubscribe.done: You're unsubscribed. We won't email you about early access again.

error.invalid: This link isn't valid. Use the unsubscribe link in the email, or send a privacy request.
error.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
